title: compat: support platform in image inspect
body:
Docker added a platform option to image inspect in API v1.49. So a multi-platform image, as example like amd64 plus arm64, can use it to say show me only the arm64 one. Podman ignores this option.

Podman now reads platform for API 1.49 and newer, and older versions ignore it like Docker does. Bad JSON or a missing operating system or architecture returns 400. If no image matches that platform, it returns 404 not found. It uses Podman's existing image lookup, which already knew how to pick a platform.

Added API tests and the Swagger doc.

One note, if we inspect by image ID, the platform isn't checked because Podman's image library skips that on purpose. Docker does check it. So we need to ask maintainers whether they want that change.

Testing: I ran the API image tests in WSL and all the new checks passed. Two old tests also fail on main too because of the old crun in WSL.

Fixes: #30332
